_note: Gold-label schema per corpus type. Each field: kind = text|number|date|enum|bool. number = plain number in the stated unit (INR crore unless noted), null when the document does not state it. Every non-null value must come with a verbatim quote from the document.

order_value.help: Total order value; convert lakh/million/USD only if the document states the INR figure, else null

award_date.help: Date of award/receipt as stated; YYYY-MM-DD

pct_of_total_shares.help: Encumbered shares as % of total share capital

beneficiary.help: Lender / entity in whose favour the encumbrance sits

results_approved.help: Were financial results approved at this meeting

dividend_per_share.help: Null when no dividend is declared/recommended

other_key_decision.help: Most material non-results decision, null if none

period.help: Period the deck reports, e.g. Q1 FY27

revenue.help: Latest-quarter revenue as printed, consolidated if both shown

lead_management_speaker.help: Name of the most senior company speaker

forward_revenue_guidance.help: Management's stated forward revenue/growth guidance, null if none

total_income.help: Standalone total income for the year unless only consolidated is shown
